changes.title: Complete bibliography editing
changes.description: Edit more bibliographic fields directly in the resource details panel, with fields that fit the resource type.

changes.title: Clearer inherited values
changes.description: See values inherited from related resources while editing, and spot errors beside the field that needs attention.

changes.title: Faster metadata entry
changes.description: Choose previously used values, edit identifiers together, and enter publication dates in one field.

changes.title: More readable editing
changes.description: Larger text and compact creator rows make the details panel easier to scan.
